gameDescriptionHtml:
Delearnia Helps You Enjoy Math Again:
Delearnia: Fractions of Hope is a story-driven adventure puzzle game with a mysterious world and a touch of mathematics. It’s a short Metroidvania… or Mathroidvania?

Here, Math Has a Purpose:
Solve unique puzzles in your own way by combining logical thinking and math. Make your way through the various obstacles and boss battles with mathemagical spells. Unlock new skills and try different strategies in your attempts to defeat your foes. Meanwhile, you’ll become more confident at handling numbers and solving math problems.

Math is a Mystery:
By chance, you become trapped in an otherworldly place, Delearnia. A world once happy and welcoming, but not anymore. This world needs healing. It needs you.

Explore the dreamlike interconnected world. Meet and interact with the residents of Delearnia. They will help you unravel the secrets of Delearnia.

“Hope is not gone. It’s just broken and trapped. Fractioned. Hidden away.”
